text:
Hadn't been back to my old stomping grounds in awhile, so I thought "Charity's Comeback" (joke) karaoke night on Thursdays sounded like a winner. And Whiskey Business delivered like it always has... Good fun vibes, strong drinks, friendly bartenders, pool, darts, and, of course, the karaoke.
The crowd was small but lively for the karaoke 9pm start-time. People were dancing, playing pool, and already singing when I walked in. And the party had patrons chilling to music and just enjoying the warm evening settling in. 
I was able to get a song in without too much wait, and that's pretty amazing! I did notice that it was different karaoke people than last time, and it was n
ot your usual karaoke crowd; not a bad thing, just an FYI. (I think I prefer the previous crew, but, that is just a side-note). 

If you're looking for a Karaoke Thursday, good drinks any day, lots of t.v.s to catch the game, a patio bite, music on the juke-box while grabbing some eats, or live-music... It's here.

My likes? The fried pickles and Bloody Mary's. I am never disappointed. 

Check their website for event info!

Be safe. Be smart. Be generous. Be kind.
Also got a Burrito Al Pastor for lunch it was more than enough and definitely delicious.  The Guacamole is very tasty.

I got the hot pot farmer's lamb. I love spicy food and it's rare for a restaurant to give me something hot enough to really hit the spot. This one did! Great flavors and heat. The cold pork belly appetizer was also tasty. And they were very accommodating of my Celiac and had a large number of options that could be prepared gluten free.

BEAST is doing an amazing job serving customers during times of COVID! The gentleman at the window made sure we were taken care of with drinks while we decided what to order and gave recommendations on what to choose. The pulled pork was so tender and the wings were juicy. They were taking great care and we felt very safe eating there. We will be back!

Amazing tacos here! My favorite is al pastor Diablo tacos. The enchiladas, nachos, ceviche are all outstanding for a quick and inexpensive dinner. 
I really enjoy making this a weekly dinner spot!
I Order from here all the time- Love their house balsamic dressing! The chicken caecer wrap, Fresca salad, and Caprese salad are some of my favorites!

We really enjoyed our visit. Our cheeseburgers were exceptional - juicy and perfectly cooked. The service was exceptional. Our bartender was Stephanie. She took great care of us. Stephanie continually checked on us. Casey, the GM,  also checked on us frequently. All the folks there were super nice. The Courtyard looked enticing - maybe next trip to NOLA in the spring. We will be back!
Always good never had a bad meal even during shutdown takeout was awesome as well. Highly recommended
Visiting from Atlanta this weekend I ate here twice already going back tomorrow before I leave everything was good Probably the best food I've had since in New Orleans
For a Saturday it was kind of slow, but after 8am it's start to pick up. As other reviewers stated the portion are huges. Not on there breakfast. They do have a great tasting coffee.
Food was great!! Service was great!! Waitress (Mina) was great and beautiful looking as well. I would recommend her all the time for our waitress .

First I want to say that I have never had such sweet waitresses. Our main waitress, Adrianna, was a doll. You'd never know the place was busy as she seemed so calm and relaxed and seemed like she was interested in the answers to her questions. It seems as if there is plenty of help as other wait staff delivered food or asked if we needed anything. Mostly young people waiting and they were extremely capable.

The place in nice and clean, well air conditioned, and has a lovely outside seating area. Bathrooms were clean as well. 

My husband had a Cuban. It had honey mustard so it was a little different, French fries and coke slaw were good. I had a caramel waffle with bacon, walnuts, cinnamon and vanilla sweetened mascarpone cheese. When Adrianna asked me how it was I said delicious but it seemed like it needed more mascarpone, or whipped cream. It would be amazing if it was served with vanilla ice cream but it would be way too filling.   She brought me a small serving of whipped cream. Deliciously perfect and so sweet of her!

The menu is filled with unique breakfast items and the coffee was good too! It's next to the Newtown Bookstore - a good place to browse.

Cucina Zapata is the best food truck on Drexel's campus in West Philly.
I saw that they had their Captain Crunch Tilapia burrito and asked if I could order the Tilapia tacos instead? They said they can make the tacos for $3 each. They put avocados, spicy mayo, salsa, cabbage and lettuce in my tacos. In addition to asking whether you want your food spicy or mild. I usually tell them to add that Sriracha sauce for the extra kick. They do not take phone call orders, It is first come, First serve. Cash Only. Their menu is a mix of Asian Fusion and Mexican. Their other menu options are Chicken Katsu tacos or over rice. If you like short ribs, they have that option too. If you're into something more savory, their Thai curry is also delicious. Lunch  hours can get crowded around 12:00 to 2:00 P.M. The truck is worth the stop, visit and catered for foodies ;P

We love the convenience of being able to walk here, but it's literally a 50/50 chance that we'll actually enjoy the food. The wings are always pretty good (sometimes amazing, sometimes just decently good) but the pizza is so hit or miss. Sometimes it's great, sometimes it's terrible - as in the slices have already  dried up and separated from each other before we get it home terrible. I think we've actually had to throw it away a couple times, which is a travesty because we are pizza worshippers. So if you catch them on an on-day you'll be v happy but catch them on an off-day and good luck to you. Great for gamblers though!!

This place was so so good! I got the fish tacos and holy moly I wish I lived closer so I could get them again!
My husband ordered the calamari and the fish n chips because we always say that whenever he gets calamari as an entree it's never enough. Well this place had a huge appetizer of calamari and he couldn't even finish his fish n chips which tasted delicious! The tarter sauce was not like normal tarter sauce which we both really liked!
We also ordered an appetizer of the dinner rolls and these rolls were so soft and doughy!
I'm giving this a 4 stars only because the service was kind of slow, they didn't clear any extra plates until we were almost done and we ordered 2 appetizers. 
The food however was great and I can't wait to go back again and try something new!

Went last night. Music was great. DJ was Definelty on point with the music . They charged both my friend and I 20 dollars cover at the door, considering that the place closed about an hour and half later. Ordered hookah and it never came.

What a wonderful and refreshing experience @ this location. Food was truly excellent and the service and the kindness that was extended to us was truly on par if not higher. We were fortunate to have "William" as our waiter; he was very kind and caring and made the visit that much better. We were both very comfortable and left feeling great. Food was 2 thumbs up. Manager on sight was extremely attentive and frequently checked up on us. Cashier, "Diamond" was very polite and kind. Truly an A+ experience. This location is truly very clean and very well run; we would return again. Kudos to the "Food Preparation" team - everything was done just right and tasted fresh.

Best hot and sour soup I have EVER had. We ordered our medium spicy and it was just absolutely perfect. The lo mein was also excellent, but we like ours thicker and firmer than some serve it. Egg rolls were good, but unique in texture and may not be for everyone. The fried dumplings were made differently than I've ever seen them done. They were much larger, flatter, and more.... flacid (?), than I've seen - but they were damn delicious. Very well cooked meat inside and that's important to me. I didn't love the meat used for the sesame chicken though. Tasted dark and stringy like old chicken thighs... or something. I didn't eat more than one or two pieces and then grossed myself out thinking it tasted like the rat I tried in Australia. Threw the rest away. My son loved his sweet and sour chicken though. My husband shared my experience with his king pao chicken. We prefer chicken breast I guess. We'd go here again but I wouldn't get a chicken dish. I bet the vegetable lo mein is perfect.

Our baby sitter ordered take out (appx $25) and delivery person said they had no change... for $40... Really.

We always tip our deliver people generously bc it's a hard but a 60% tip. Not okay dude.
Best mussels in Nola, hands down. A lovely experience for our family. Service was great and the entire family loved the experience.
Karen was GREAT...nice clean place with good eats!  I had lunch ribs.  The sauce is my fav.
Spent over 50 dollars for 2 pizzas that were crap! All I tasted was the oils and garlic. For the price I paid you would think they would give you a good pizza. Never eating there again.

I was hesitated to go here because I'm asian and this place looks not authentic and waiting for disappointment. I see white and black dudes are cooking in kitchen. Lol so sorry. 
But finally I gave a try. 
It was surprisingly good! It's pricey but it's all good. My kids loved all dishes too. 
Korean double fried chicken wings are amazing!
We will be back to try some more.

So I was going to come here for the first time and was disappointed because the hostess didn't try to accommodate us at all. I was trying to put us on the waitlist and she said "well just to let you know it's going to be like 3 hours until people leave." She then proceeded to tell me to look at the bar to see if there's anything open, so we did and nothing was open. I went back to hostess to put us on the waitlist and she said , "well it's going be a long wait like 3 hours."and I was like well can you just put us on the waitlist anyways instead of just saying NO to me. She was like "well I'm just letting you know." Well guess what we left and they called us back in like 10 minutes not 3. We had already left but you see this is unacceptable to dismiss a customer like that. Not happy one bit. Train your hostesses better please.
Delicious food and awesome atmosphere! Potatoes and pickle fries were amazing. Our waiter was really nice too.

Admittedly, I've never eaten at a Sizzler..  but our family, on the 12 hour drive home, decided to stop and grab dinner.  Could not be happier!  First thing I see upon walking in is a happy hostess who was extremely nice and at the salad bar an employee very nicely asking a patron to wear a mask...  not judgmentally nor rudely, but in a way where everyone was smiling and went about their way.  We opted to sit outside (they have outside seating) and our waitress was very nice and helpful and the food was delicious and a great value...  I had the trio, kids had steak bites, and my wife had hibachi combo...  all was wonderful.  Great experience.

Love this place! We went in wanting to try a bunch of different things and left impressed. Everything was delicious (we did two entrees, 3 apps and each had a signature drink). Reasonably priced and the decor is perfect. Definitely recommend trying this place

This is super close to my house so it's my go to place when I don't feel like cooking. It's a friendly atmosphere and the food is great. Never disappoints! My favorite dishes are the prime rib salad, Maggie's chicken, drunken chicken, the beef tips appetizer and the Reuben egg rolls! There's some kind of entertainment just about every night of the week. Servers are awesome! They seem to attract the real go getters! They never stop!! Our favorite is Leza!!

This place was okay, location was great! And for how busy it was, it didn't take too long but the food was just okay. We ordered beer which was great but our glasses were soaking wet and smelled like fish which wasn't the best but we didn't make a fuss. Overall, I imagine there are better places to eat but location wise, it's right on the pier, so if you care more about location, I would choose this. I would come here again if someone said they wanted to go, but I wouldn't suggest it visiting.

My kids love the Cheesecake Factory!! I love the consistency of my favorite meals. The herb crusted salmon never disappoints. Irene was our server and was wonderful. She took the time to make my daughters birthday lunch a bit more special.  We appreciate the food and environment for families.

Delicious pizza and fun spot! I love the pretzel bites as an appetizer! The pizza and calzones are good. My only drawback is the dough is kind of yeasty so that's not my fave part but it's still really good.

The decor and vibe is 100% on point. The patio is also so cool and one of the best parts of the restaurant.

Check it out and enjoy being mellow

Love this place! The drinks and atmosphere are top notch. The bartender is really friendly provided great conversation. The whisky collection is very good for Reno providing a great selection for whisky aficionados. To top it off, the old fashioned cocktail has bacon in it! Highly recommended.
I've had the pizza a few times since and it wasn't overloaded with oregano. Probably just a mistake the first time. This is actually my favorite place for  pan pizza now.
Food was very good. Outside seating have some mosquitos. I like mojito cocktail the taste so good. I'll be back again!!

Was walking by and realized their upper deck patios were open and decided to stop in for a few drinks. 

Brandon, and I cannot remember his friends name were both wonderful host, in my case bartenders. Brandon if you remember me you called me "Jacob" from California.

I forgot to take pictures of the other drinks ( bummer) but Brandon made sure we were taking care of us. He made us feel at home very comfortable share some of his experiences about NOLA he loves!

Have had both in restaurant and delivery meals and both were delicious. The last time I ordered pork spicy tonkatsu ramen for delivery. The soup arrived hot and was packaged well. I would like to see larger plastic spoons, but other than that, it was good and had just the right amount of spice. 

I've also eaten gyoza there and the sauce is well made - just enough tang to make the dumpling flavorful. Would definitely recommend both.
Ordered online at 6:40 and went to pick up my food, but the computers were down. Waited until 7:50 just for them to tell me they're only accepting cash. Ridiculous.
I'm not sure why this place doesn't have great reviews!! This place is awesome! The atmosphere is cute- good service- not busy AT ALL !! And AWESOMEEEE sushi!! I recommend the dragon roll OMG!

We have gotten take out twice here since the pandemic quarantine.  Extremely accommodating owner and delicious food!  Tonight I ordered the Rigatoni alla Bascaiola.  It is a pasta dish with mushroom, peas, sweet sausage and Parmigiano in a light cream sauce. It was really wonderful.  I rarely like food that I order out, but this place really does it right.  Large menu.  Reasonable prices.

Brutal. Nothing better to say- 

- waited 1 hour 15 minutes for a table we reserved. 
- was told we'd be given small plates at the table to compensate for the wait
- had to ask for them to do what they said they would do, bring out the small plates - to which they not only balked, but brought out a cold Margherita pizza in its stead. 
- food was mixed - some good main plates. The desserts were a full blown mess, served sloppy and without much flavor. Avoid the chocolate panacotta - horrible. 
- the service was probably the worst part of the experience. Our waitress had an attitude from the first minute she came to our table. Was trying to rush us yet was never around to get drinks refilled or tend to our needs. She knew little of the menu and was snippy when one guest asked about an unlisted item, saying that if you don't see it then it's not there. 

Never. Ever. Again.

I used to enjoy coming here, there were a few servers who made it enjoyable. I came in the other night and someone was complaining about being there longer than they were supposed to, saying they wouldn't wait another table. I saw a young cook who looked to be in training reach into a bin and put food in his mouth, with his cooking gloves on that weren't changed after. I felt like saying something but it was before my food was cooked. I say cooked but it must not have been cooked well enough because I spent the last 24 hours with food poisoning.

OK, I have admitted in the past that I am not a big Mexican food fan but my wife and father-in-law like it.  Last evening we went to Cabos for dinner to try the new place out and here are my personal thoughts.
Positives:  We were seated quickly and the service was very good.  Our waitress was Katie, a tiny, super cute lady that took very good care of us throughout our meal.  She checked on us frequently and we wanted for nothing.  She did an excellent job.  
I ordered steak fajitas, my wife ordered  Chili Verde with pork and my father-in-law ordered the tortilla soup.  My fajitas were very tasty and the portion was large.  The tortillas and the usual sides that came with my dinner were very good too.  Everything came out hot from the kitchen and the food runners were also very attentive.  I couldn't even finish all of the fajitas and packed up the remainder to take home.   My wife loved her dish and my father-in-law was very pleased also.  All things considered, it was a very good dining experience.  I would have given 4-stars if I were a Mexican food fan.  I am certain that my wife and her dad would give Cabos 4 or maybe even 5 stars.  They were quite pleased with their fare.
Negatives:  The place is very loud due to the fact that there is nothing but interior hard surfaces.  Therefore, the sound bounces off of everything in there.   The Margaritas could have a bit more tequila in them.  They were pretty mild.  
If you like Mexican food and live locally I am sure you will en

This place has a fabulous view and the food is phenomenal.  Island flavor food while taking in the fabulous view of the bay.  I had the chicken with flavored rice and mango salsa and it was packed full with flavor.  Drinks are great.  Service wonderful.  Will definitely return.
Simply delicious. All the meats were tender and juicy. Good amount of smoke. I got the double wide and it was plenty to share between 2+ people.

One of the best Happy Hour restaurants in Santa Barbara (4:00-8:00PM) daily.
Great selection ranging from steamed mussels to Kobe beef sliders.
My wife and I visit this place at least once a month. Their happy hour is one of the best in Santa Barbara, 
Our favorite items from the Happy Hour menu are, the steamed mussels prepared in garlic sauce, fried calamaris and mesquite grilled artichoke.
From the main menu my favorite is the blackened mahi-mahi. 
The happy hour wine and beer start at $4.00 and margaritas from $5.50. Excellent parking at the train station adjacent to Enterprise (90 minutes free)

Great quality pizza with fresh toppings and thin, but chewy crust. Picked up takeout a couple times and it has never disappointed.  Look forward to trying their other pizzas. 
 
Garlic knots: 4/5
Supreme: 5/5
Old South: 5/5

We live within walking distance, and we eat out fairly often, so pre-COVID-19 we used to hit up Maloney's two or three nights per week. I absolutely love their chicken and veggies entree and the bowl version with rice. I missed it more than I imagined while they were closed.

Today we had our "first meal" out in the real world after restaurants were allowed to reopen at limited capacity, and Maloney's did not disappoint. Slightly weird with so few tables inside, but everything was great and it was so nice to see people out and about again!

This location never disappoints. They have the best service, best food, & best ambience. It's affordable for a family too! I came here for lunch two times! They have really good French Onion Soup too.

We came from SF. We were looking for something to eat and the owner was out side and invited or large party in. We asked for recommendations and he was right, every single thing I ate here was amazing. Love this place. Best meal I have had in Reno. Prices are amazing. This place is amazing!!!!

I really did not want to sit at home with an entire box of donuts during quarantine. Well I did, but I didn't you know?....Anyway Dottie's made it way too easy for me to order them online and pick them up from their window the next morning. 

I am personally not vegan, but I do try to watch my meat consumption as I hear it could help with energy and acne so truth be told I didn't buy these because they were vegan. I bought them because they looked absolutely delicious and I am team Donut. While they were delicious, not exactly what I was expecting. They were much chewier and dense than I imagined. Don't let their delicate yeast donut appearance fool you. these are not donuts you can just keep popping in your mouth. I was full after a couple bites.

Head's up though, you MUST pre-order these 24 hours ahead of time on their website and you can't pick which flavors they give you. Sort of like an omakase experience here since I guess they don't want to have to put up with picky consumers. Don't be weird. Enjoy the flavors they give you and be thankful that you're fortunate enough to be buying donuts at a time like this.
